requirements.text: Some experience with Go Lang and/or Typescript, with a passion for growing in a full-stack role.
Strong experience with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks such as React) and backend frameworks (e.g., Express, FastAPI), along with related libraries such as Pydantic.
Enthusiasm for open-source projects and contributions is a strong plus.
Eager to tackle challenges, learn from feedback, and work collaboratively within a dynamic team environment.
Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and collaborate with other developers and non-technical team members.
